content.short: Keeta Network is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain designed as an institutional financial settlement layer.
content.description: Keeta Network is a next-generation Layer 1 blockchain engineered as a secure and scalable financial settlement layer for the global economy. Utilizing a unique DAG structure and 'atomic architecture,' the network achieves massive throughput with sub-second finality. Keeta positions itself as a robust alternative to traditional banking rails, featuring built-in compliance and native engines for RWA tokenization. Backed by industry leaders, Keeta aims to bridge traditional finance and blockchain, empowering institutions and developers to build global financial services on-chain.
